about_the_game:
Step Inside Her World

You’re not just visiting—you’re part of Sophia’s life. In Her Place VR, experience an immersive and interactive world where you can talk, relax, and enjoy unforgettable moments with her. Whether you’re watching her dance, capturing stunning photos, or simply sharing time together, every moment feels personal and real.

What Awaits You?

🛋️ A Fully Interactive Home – Explore Sophia’s beautifully detailed personal space, filled with objects you can touch and interact with.
💃 Dynamic Poses & Dance – Watch Sophia move with grace as she dazzles with elegant dance performances, showcasing fluid movements and captivating rhythms that truly enchant.
📸 Photo Mode – Use your photography skills to guide her in striking the perfect pose and capturing genuine, unforgettable moments.
🎭 Customizable Outfits & Styles – Choose from a range of outfits to dress Sophia, letting her showcase a variety of stylish looks that capture your unique taste.
🗣️ Natural Conversations – Talk with Sophia and experience fluid, lifelike interactions.
✨ Realistic Physics & Presence – A next-gen physics system brings Sophia to life, making every movement and interaction feel smooth, natural, and immersive.

A New Standard in Virtual Companionship

Powered by high-fidelity visuals, expressive motion, and advanced physics, Her Place VR delivers a deeply immersive experience that feels personal and engaging. Whether you’re sharing a quiet moment on the couch or exploring new ways to interact, this is more than just a simulation—it’s her world, and you’re part of it.

Are you ready to step inside?

content_descriptors.notes: This game is intended for mature audiences (18+). It features explicit adult content, including full nudity, detailed depictions of genitalia, and consensual sexual activities. Players can interact with the in-game character by selecting outfits, positioning them, guiding them through exercises or dance routines, and more.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 or equivalent
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, SteamVR. Oculus Touch/Valve Index controllers or better
  • Additional Notes: For optimal performance, use a high-end VR headset and ensure your system meets or exceeds these specifications.

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
